{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | timestamp = 00:05:30.180

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = No, so it could have so easily been another Santa Claus

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:43.339
    | text      = say hello to Friendship,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:44.779
    | text      = and be on my way.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:45.620
    | text      = Because I'd learned the lesson of Santa Claus.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:48.220
    | text      = So I get to town.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | timestamp = 00:05:49.860
    | text      = Main drag of Friendship, Indiana.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:52.740
    | text      = There's a big sign that says,

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:56.300
    | text      = And then it's folded up by the wind.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

    | timestamp = 00:06:06.740
    | text      = I thought this is nice.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:07.939
    | text      = So I decided to walk around a little bit.

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = I would move out of any town named a thing.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:40.379
    | text      = Nope, I'm out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:41.439
    | text      = If I was born and raised in Friendship,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:43.899

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = I can't wait until I get the fuck out of this place
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:47.819
    | text      = so people will stop saying the word Friendship to me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:50.019
    | text      = I was tickled by all of it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:51.980
    | text      = So I'm walking around.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:53.139
    | text      = I'm seeing this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:54.300
    | text      = I'm charmed by the weirdness and quirkiness of it all.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:59.139
    | text      = I take a turn on Friendship Street.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:01.740
    | text      = I don't remember what the main street is,

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:03.139
    | text      = but there's another street, Friendship Street.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:05.360
    | text      = I'm walking down it a little bit.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:06.620
    | text      = And I see like, okay, down the road,
}}

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:11.540
    | text      = But then I turn to the side and I see a house

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = I got out of there.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:32.300
    | text      = Friendship was ruined.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:35.100
    | text      = It's so funny.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = I swear to you, it's so funny
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:39.019
    | text      = because after you said there were two Sambo statues,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = I was like, wait, are we saying that?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = It was weird to see.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = I bet.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:47.579
    | text      = And the thing that it made me think of is like,

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = It symbolizes the fractures that are inherent

    | timestamp = 00:08:31.620
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:33.500
    | text      = I think that the reason I wanted to tell you this story
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:49.299
    | text      = It's like, I think there's a certain charm and a quirk

    | text      = to friendship school and friendship insurance.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = And all of a sudden, then you walk down the street

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

    | timestamp = 00:09:05.299

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

    | timestamp = 00:36:15.639
    | text      = The only place he felt safe, he said, to come out and speak.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:18.559
    | text      = Where he wouldn't be taken out of context.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:21.360
    | text      = And I said, Charlie, you're so on target with this
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:27.119
    | text      = that there's a good chance they'll ignore it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:30.079
    | text      = Because it'll be so mainline and the facts you lay out
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:32.320
    | text      = will be so documented that they can't attack you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:34.440
    | text      = This isn't something dirty to say about you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:37.000
    | text      = I predicted that there'd be a predominant blackout
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:40.559
    | text      = in the mainstream media on this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:44.159
    | text      = And other people are like, oh, no way, man.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:46.119
    | text      = I mean, if a Hollywood person falls off their bicycle,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:50.239
    | text      = especially Charlie Sheen, I said, just watch.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:54.320
    | text      = And then we get a call from AP.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:36:59.599
    | text      = We're talking to them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:01.199
    | text      = They're going to do a story.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:02.360
    | text      = We're hiding the interview.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:03.440
    | text      = Nothing happens.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:04.239
    | text      = We call AP out in LA, talk to their head guy out there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:07.880
    | text      = Jeff Williams, I believe is the name,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:10.039
    | text      = left the notes at the home office.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:11.679
    | text      = Should have brought those with me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:13.079
    | text      = Yeah, it's Jeff Williams.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:14.559
    | text      = And he's just, well, yeah, Alex, what do you want?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:17.280
    | text      = Just real tough guy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:21.239
    | text      = You got that whole MO about him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:23.199
    | text      = Wonder if he's seen some tours of Southeast Asia.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:25.320
    | text      = I wonder what he's been up to.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:26.559
    | text      = But important to see him there at AP in Los Angeles
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:29.599
    | text      = over the propaganda bureau.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:31.559
    | text      = Seemed like an experienced fellow.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:32.960
    | text      = And I'm like, yeah, you guys aren't going to run this story?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:39.119
    | text      = And he goes, no, we're not.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:40.519
    | text      = I know all about Charlie Sheen.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:42.159
    | text      = I personally don't care what he says.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:44.119
    | text      = I go, oh, but is it newsworthy, Mr. Williams?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:47.599
    | text      = Your very office, your very AP office
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:50.320
    | text      = put out the Santana story.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:52.159
    | text      = Carlos Santana just with a milqueto statement,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:37:55.599
    | text      = I said a tame statement about he disagrees with the war
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:01.360
    | text      = and that he's into peace and love, a different philosophy
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:03.679
    | text      = than Bush.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:04.639
    | text      = He said, oh, whatever.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:05.639
    | text      = And I said, well, I need to quote you on this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:08.159
    | text      = Are you saying this isn't newsworthy?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:11.280
    | text      = And he said, we're not going to run anything.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:13.599
    | text      = And I said, is it newsworthy to have Charlie Sheen saying
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:16.599
    | text      = Bush is arrogant?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:17.719
    | text      = Wouldn't you normally run that if it wasn't attached
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:19.840
    | text      = to all this 9-11 information?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:21.760
    | text      = And he said, you're not going to bait me and slam the phone
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:25.159
    | text      = down.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:27.239
    | text      = You're not going to bait me, cling.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:30.760
    | text      = And then I called back and woman answered, she's like,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:32.960
    | text      = they must have odd x or phone numbers.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:34.679
    | text      = She's like, yes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:36.000
    | text      = And I go, what's your name?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:37.400
    | text      = I'm Alex Jones.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:38.039
    | text      = She goes, I'm not going to talk to you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:39.619
    | text      = I'll send you back to Mr. Williams.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:43.480
    | text      = And I'm like, don't you think this is newsworthy?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:47.960
    | text      = Don't you think Charlie Sheen is newsworthy?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:52.920
    | text      = I mean, regardless of what you think of him personally,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:56.239
    | text      = isn't this newsworthy?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:57.760
    | text      = And she hung up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:38:59.400
    | text      = And I said, all right, baby.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:01.039
    | text      = My wife is sitting by me at her terminal.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:02.840
    | text      = I said, I'm going to call The Hollywood Reporter.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:06.159
    | text      = So what's going on here is that Alex
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:08.239
    | text      = doesn't understand how entertainment reporting works.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:11.280
    | text      = Celebrities, particularly ones who
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:12.920
    | text      = do a lot of live performances, say a ton of crazy shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:15.840
    | text      = And media outlets aren't going to just report on all of it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:19.599
    | text      = Some things get recorded.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:21.119
    | text      = And they're just inevitable to become public conversations,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:23.599
    | text      = like when Michael Richards had his racist meltdown
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:26.000
    | text      = at the Laugh Factory.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:27.239
    | text      = There's no way to get around that getting talked about.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:30.840
    | text      = But other stuff, what you might call more marginal comments,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:34.119
    | text      = generally get reported on or not based on publicists.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:39.039
    | text      = On its own, Charlie Sheen said something weird.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:42.039
    | text      = That isn't a story that's going to sell itself to an outlet.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:45.079
    | text      = And Charlie's publicity team isn't
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:46.920
    | text      = going to get behind promoting his appearance on Alex's show.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:50.400
    | text      = Conversely, Santana's reps are obviously doing their job
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:53.880
    | text      = and helping push the story about him being anti-Bush,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:56.639
    | text      = because that's his brand.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:39:58.280
    | text      = And this is a puff piece kind of thing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:00.840
    | text      = in the entertainment papers.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:03.199
    | text      = Entertainment news isn't the same as news news.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:05.960
    | text      = And unfortunately, Alex doesn't really
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:07.559
    | text      = understand how either works.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:09.679
    | text      = Charlie Sheen being on Infowars and saying
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:11.639
    | text      = that he doesn't trust the mainstream narrative about 9-11
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:14.079
    | text      = isn't newsworthy in terms of the real world
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:17.239
    | text      = or what you'd put in the main sections of the newspaper.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:21.639
    | text      = It arguably could be newsworthy for places like TMZ
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:25.840
    | text      = that do celebrity gossip.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:28.039
    | text      = But the problem is that at this point in 2006,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:30.639
    | text      = Charlie's on a top-rated network sitcom.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:33.079
    | text      = And his reps are interested in keeping things that way.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:36.119
    | text      = He's a guy with a rocky, troubled past
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:38.320
    | text      = who the tabloids love talking about.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:40.320
    | text      = So if anything, there's a good chance
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:42.480
    | text      = that Charlie's publicity team is working against Alex
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:45.599
    | text      = in terms of trying to keep this interview lower profile.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:49.639
    | text      = Alex's phone call stories, those aren't true.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:51.800
    | text      = But they do depict something that is real, which
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:54.320
    | text      = is that he's a bad publicist.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:56.000
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:56.920
    | text      = He doesn't understand.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:40:58.679
    | text      = I mean, I get that he's a psycho, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:04.639
    | text      = So he doesn't understand this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:05.920
    | text      = But to me, if I'm at all personally speaking
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:10.599
    | text      = to Charlie Sheen, Charlie Sheen himself saying something
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:13.320
    | text      = along the lines of, I would like it
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:15.119
    | text      = so people didn't take me out of context and all of this stuff,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:17.920
    | text      = right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:18.559
    | text      = To then shop around that he was on your show to other places
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:24.559
    | text      = to try and get them to literally take him out of context.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:27.760
    | text      = Yeah, so I called The Hollywood Reporter.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:29.719
    | text      = Right, exactly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:31.320
    | text      = How are you not selling out your friend?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:33.480
    | text      = This is exactly the same sort of behavior
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:35.599
    | text      = as after Charlie had his freak out five years later,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:38.400
    | text      = Alex going on The View, doing the media rounds
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:41.280
    | text      = that he could do in order to associate himself.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:43.320
    | text      = I can sell this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:43.960
    | text      = Yes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:44.960
    | text      = He's a bad person.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:46.079
    | text      = He's a bad person.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:49.679
    | text      = He's being homophobic abstractly and then also just trying
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:54.719
    | text      = to exploit this person.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:56.760
    | text      = Yeah, I mean, in a way, there's something of a morality
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:41:59.679
    | text      = play to his entire life.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:01.199
    | text      = Everything he does is something of a Punch and Judy show
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:04.280
    | text      = where it's like at the end of it, kids should go,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:06.719
    | text      = and now we don't do that, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:09.320
    | text      = That's how this goes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:10.920
    | text      = You treat your friends better than that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:13.199
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:15.760
    | text      = God, it just doesn't, you know, the consequences
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:20.159
    | text      = aren't automatic, it turns out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:21.679
    | text      = No, that's the problem.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:22.760
    | text      = That's the problem with, you know,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:24.480
    | text      = we're capable of thought, but animals learn
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:27.679
    | text      = by very quick consequences.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:29.360
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:29.960
    | text      = And I think that everyone is so wrapped up in appearances,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:33.159
    | text      = especially these days now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:34.400
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:36.079
    | text      = And even, I say these days, extending a ways back.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:38.280
    | text      = Sure, yeah, yeah, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:39.079
    | text      = People were really caught up in the idea
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:40.800
    | text      = of what they thought Alex was.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:42.639
    | text      = And they got bit by treating him like he was that,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:47.320
    | text      = as opposed to what he actually is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:49.039
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:49.679
    | text      = And that, I think, is one of the large themes of the Charlie
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:52.639
    | text      = Sheen and Alex play.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:55.599
    | text      = You know, to bring it back to Alex's territory,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:42:58.599
    | text      = it's almost like that by the fruits of their actions,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:02.679
    | text      = and not the way it looks.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:04.639
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:05.119
    | text      = You know?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:05.480
    | text      = Maybe, I don't know if somebody said something

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:07.119
    | text      = about that a while back.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = William Shpekspere.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = that I can't remember now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:43:15.480
    | text      = Anyway, no one cares about this Charlie Sheen interview
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = which Alex isn't supposed to like.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:40.159
    | text      = And he's very clear that he does not like.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:42.559
    | text      = The way they're dealing with the Charlie Sheen interview
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:50:52.280

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
